meta.subject: two TLBs to fix memory system deadlock

en.summary: Fixes a memory-system deadlock by replacing a single shared Gemmini translation path with per-client TLB/PTW resources for concurrent DMA clients.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the change fixes a memory-system deadlock.
The patch changes central translation hardware structure in Controller.scala and FrontendTLB.scala.
The fix removes a single shared TLB/PTW bottleneck and gives each client its own translation and exception path.
evidence: Controller.scala increases nPTWPorts from 1 to 2 and vectors the PTW and exception interfaces instead of sharing one instance.
FrontendTLB.scala replaces one RRArbiter plus one DecoupledTLB with Seq.fill(nClients)(Module(new DecoupledTLB(...))).
Flush and interrupt handling are converted from single signals to per-client vectors reduced with OR, matching the move away from one shared translator.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: If multiple accelerator memory clients share a single translation engine, PTW path, or tightly coupled translation-response channel, backpressure from one client can block the other while both still hold resources needed for forward progress. Under the wrong dependency cycle, this forms a memory-system deadlock. The safe design pattern is to separate translation state per client or otherwise guarantee that one client cannot monopolize translation progress needed by another.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: shared TLB/PTW arbitration between concurrent accelerator DMA clients
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Two independent memory clients issue overlapping translations or TLB misses while shared translation resources, retries, or flush handling create a circular wait.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Collapse per-client translation resources back into one arbitrated TLB/PTW path shared by all clients.
portability_notes: Map this to any accelerator that has separate load/store DMA engines, read/write streams, or prefetch versus writeback clients.
The fault should target translation concurrency, not the data-mover datapath itself.
Deadlock may require stress: simultaneous misses, full queues, or memory backpressure.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify multiple accelerator memory clients that currently own independent translation state or PTW access.
Route those clients through one shared translation request arbiter and one shared miss-handling resource.
Share the exception or flush interface as a single channel instead of per-client channels.
Keep the rest of each DMA datapath intact so the loss of translation isolation is the primary reintroduced fault.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Gemmini FrontendTLB arbitration and PTW port provisioning for multiple DMA clients
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes Gemmini from one PTW port and one shared FrontendTLB/exception interface to per-client PTW, exception, and DecoupledTLB instances.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore nPTWPorts = 1, a single TLBPTWIO and TLBExceptionIO, and the RRArbiter plus one DecoupledTLB structure that all clients share.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Concurrent Gemmini clients can deadlock the memory system or stall indefinitely when translation misses and shared translation backpressure line up unfavorably.
evidence_for_injection: The commit title explicitly names a memory-system deadlock.
The patch moves from one shared translator to one translator per client rather than merely retuning timing.
PTW port count and flush/interrupt handling are widened in the controller to support independent translation progress.
notes: Reproducing the fault typically requires overlapping activity from at least two memory clients.
Because the original fix is structural, the portable injection should focus on restoring the shared bottleneck, not on line-for-line reversal outside this mechanism.

zh.summary: 该提交通过为并发 DMA 客户端提供独立的 TLB/PTW 资源，替代原先单一共享的 Gemmini 地址翻译路径，从而修复了内存系统死锁。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明这是为修复 memory-system deadlock。
补丁修改的是 Controller.scala 与 FrontendTLB.scala 中的核心翻译硬件结构。
修复移除了单一共享的 TLB/PTW 瓶颈，为每个客户端提供独立的翻译与异常路径。
evidence: Controller.scala 把 nPTWPorts 从 1 提升到 2，并把 PTW 与异常接口改成向量形式，而不是共享单个实例。
FrontendTLB.scala 用 Seq.fill(nClients)(Module(new DecoupledTLB(...))) 替换了“一个 RRArbiter + 一个 DecoupledTLB”。
flush 和 interrupt 处理也从单信号改成按客户端分离后再 OR 聚合，这与“取消单一共享翻译器”完全一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 如果多个加速器访存客户端共享同一个地址翻译引擎、PTW 路径或强耦合的翻译响应通道，那么其中一个客户端产生的背压就可能阻塞另一个客户端，而双方又分别持有对方前进所需的资源。在错误的依赖环下，这会形成内存系统死锁。更安全的设计模式是为每个客户端分离翻译状态，或者至少保证一个客户端不能独占另一个客户端所需的翻译前进资源。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 并发加速器 DMA 客户端之间共享的 TLB/PTW 仲裁路径
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 两个独立访存客户端同时发起翻译或 TLB miss，而共享翻译资源、重试逻辑或 flush 处理形成循环等待。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把每客户端独立的翻译资源重新折叠为一个由所有客户端共享的仲裁 TLB/PTW 路径。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 重新引入共享翻译器瓶颈
portability_notes: 可映射到任何拥有独立 load/store DMA、读/写流，或 prefetch/writeback 客户端的加速器。
故障注入应针对翻译并发性，而不是数据搬运 datapath 本身。
死锁通常需要压力条件：并发 miss、队列占满或内存背压。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到当前拥有独立翻译状态或独立 PTW 访问能力的多个加速器访存客户端。
把这些客户端重新汇聚到一个共享的翻译请求仲裁器和一个共享的 miss 处理资源上。
把异常或 flush 接口也改回单通道共享，而不是每客户端独立通道。
保持各 DMA 数据通路其它部分不变，使“丧失翻译隔离”成为被重新引入的主要缺陷。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Gemmini 多个 DMA 客户端的 FrontendTLB 仲裁与 PTW 端口配置
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 Gemmini 从“1 个 PTW 端口 + 1 个共享 FrontendTLB/异常接口”改成了每客户端独立的 PTW、异常接口和 DecoupledTLB 实例。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 nPTWPorts = 1、单个 TLBPTWIO/单个 TLBExceptionIO，以及“RRArbiter + 一个 DecoupledTLB 供所有客户端共享”的结构。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当翻译 miss 与共享翻译背压以不利方式叠加时，并发 Gemmini 客户端可能让内存系统进入死锁或长期停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 提交标题直接写明是 memory-system deadlock。
补丁不是简单调时序，而是把共享翻译器改成每客户端独立翻译器。
controller 中 PTW 端口数以及 flush/interrupt 处理都被扩展，以支持独立翻译前进。
notes: 通常需要至少两个访存客户端同时活跃才能稳定复现该缺陷。
由于原始修复是结构性重构，可移植的注入重点应放在“恢复共享瓶颈”上，而不是逐行反向回退无关细节。
